Senior Backend Engineer

Globex Systems is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and operate the
services behind our data platform.

Responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate reliable backend services in Python.
- Own data pipelines that process high-volume event streams.
- Improve API performance and reliability through measurement.
- Collaborate on code review and mentor junior engineers.

Requirements
- 5+ years building production backend systems.
- Strong Python and SQL skills.
- Experience with AWS (or an equivalent cloud platform).
- Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.
